scientific_integrity: Exact finite generator reconstruction and symbolic rational certificate; analytical Descartes root count; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple undirected graph source-normalized SIS with strictly positive spontaneous infection and transmission; sharp result is for four-cycle versus one added diagonal, with a three-site minimality result. No assertion of arbitrary-graph monotonicity, empirical estimation, or historical completeness.
title: A sharp importation threshold for edge suppression in degree-normalized epidemic transmission
